title: Budget-matched multi-objective optimizer comparison for Symthaea casting research

run_design.objective_evaluation_accounting: Every objective-oracle call consumes one unit, including infeasible, invalid, timed-out, crashed, or otherwise failed evaluations. Candidate proposals and acquisition optimization are not objective evaluations; they are recorded in wall-clock and compute costs.
run_design.adaptivity: All seeds, budget points, target thresholds, reference points, metrics, and analysis rules must be frozen before examining algorithm results.

suites.reference_point_policy: Fixed per suite instance and shared by all algorithms; minimize both objectives. Never choose reference points per run or algorithm.
Use only the official suite's predeclared metric/reference convention or freeze a single documented per-instance reference before results; do not synthesize algorithm-specific reference points.
Freeze objective units/scales, feasibility rules, simulator revision and reference point before the first comparison. Synthetic and simulator-only results cannot be labelled physical validation.

baseline_lock.rule: This protocol is not execution-ready until every required baseline, suite adapter, and environment has immutable identifiers. Do not substitute 'latest' for a version.

definitions.zdt_standard: Primary for the fixed-reference 2D ZDT track is normalized stepwise hypervolume AUC independently recomputed from the immutable JSONL evaluation trace. After each objective call, record exact feasible-archive hypervolume; carry the last observed hypervolume through any unused part of the planned budget after a predeclared early stop; divide the sum by planned_budget times the fixed ideal-to-reference rectangle area. Use ideal [0,0] and reference [1.1,1.1] for the stated ZDT suite; the normalization area is 1.21. Values are supplementary and must not be conflated with COCO's native metric.
definitions.coco_bbob_biobj: Use COCO's official target-reaching/runtime and ECDF methodology, prescribed normalized objective-space conventions, and official target sets as the primary result. The custom hypervolume AUC is supplementary only and must never replace or be presented as the official COCO metric.
definitions.casting_simulator: Report best quality achieved at fixed declared fidelity-aware cost budgets, with a separately reported per-run trace-derived quality curve. Freeze all objective units, constraints, reference points, fidelity costs, and analysis before unsealing final seeds.

primary_metric.common_reporting: Report final hypervolume, feasibility/failure counts, runtime and paired per-task uncertainty. Do not collapse suites with incompatible official indicators into one unlabeled scalar ranking.

stretch_targets_not_current_results.note: Aspirational evaluation gates only. They are not current measured performance or a guarantee of superiority.

evidence_classes.synthetic: Known-answer stress tests; supports code-path and mechanism claims only.
evidence_classes.benchmark: Frozen public test suites; supports claims bounded to those suites and budgets.
evidence_classes.simulator: A specified simulator with frozen parameters; supports simulation claims only.
evidence_classes.physical: Held-out manufacturing observations with documented provenance and process coverage; required for real foundry performance claims.

publication_gate: Exact known-answer tests pass on the exact commit.
All required baseline and environment identifiers are hash locked.
The receipt validator passes for every run, and every run is accounted for, including failures and refusals.
The primary metric is recomputed independently from the raw trace.
No skipped, queued, incomplete, or missing run is reported as successful.
Per-task paired effects and uncertainty intervals are provided.
Synthetic, public benchmark, simulator, and physical findings are labelled separately.

multifidelity_extension.motivation: Casting search naturally spans cheap approximations, reduced-order or intermediate-resolution models, high-fidelity multiphysics solvers, and physical foundry observations. A call-count-only comparison can reward methods that spend more on costly evaluations unless the fidelity mix and fidelity-specific costs are recorded.
rules: Each fidelity-level oracle call counts as one objective evaluation; failed, invalid and infeasible calls still count.
Per-run fidelity call counts must sum exactly to the objective-evaluation count and fidelity cost keys must exactly match fidelity-count keys.
Report both raw objective calls and fidelity-specific cost units; do not compare methods on call count alone when costs differ.
Never treat low/medium outputs as high-fidelity labels without a declared discrepancy model trained on paired samples.
Predeclare high-fidelity budget floors and promotion thresholds before seeing test results.
Audit false-promotion rate, high-fidelity constraint confirmation, rank/Pareto misclassification, and quality achieved per fixed high-fidelity cost.
Simulator fidelity is not physical validation; physical observations require separate data provenance and process-shift evaluation.
Abstain or promote additional candidates when fidelity discrepancy leaves the calibrated range; do not silently extrapolate the correction.

raw_trace_contract.format: UTF-8 JSON Lines; one JSON object per objective-oracle call; no blank lines; exact raw bytes hashed in the run receipt.
raw_trace_contract.status_semantics: Only feasible rows enter the unconstrained 2D hypervolume archive. Infeasible rows may contain valid objective values but are excluded from the archive. Invalid and failed rows must set objectives=null. All rows consume one objective evaluation.
raw_trace_contract.strictness: Unknown keys, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite numbers, inconsistent status counts, index gaps, trace hash mismatch and objective values below the locked ideal point are rejected.
raw_trace_contract.scorer_scope: v1 independent scorer supports only single-fidelity, 2-objective, minimize-all runs; all other modes/dimensions fail closed until an independently tested scorer is added.
